description:
crate-jmap-mail-server/src/vacation.rs:253 emits a release-mode `eprintln!("WARN: VacationResponse upsert rollback failed")`. Library code should not log to stderr — operators may not have stderr captured, and there is no log filtering.

Other eprintln! in the file at lines 304, 314, 324, 332, 342 are gated by `#[cfg(debug_assertions)]` so they vanish in release. Only :253 leaks.

Options:
1. Convert to `tracing::warn!` (preferred). The crate's AGENTS.md restricts deps to 'jmap-types, jmap-mail-types, jmap-server, tokio, thiserror only' — adding tracing requires explicit user approval. jmap-mail-server is also a LOCKED crate.
2. Return the rollback failure via the error path (probably the right answer — the caller can decide whether to log).
3. Gate with `#[cfg(debug_assertions)]` to match the rest of the file.

LOCKED crate per AGENTS.md — needs Mark's approval before edit.
title: P2: mail-server/vacation.rs:253 release-mode eprintln! for WARN logging path
